source_facts: Binary decode looks up a field descriptor by field number.
For unknown fields, bytes are appended to message unknown storage iff DiscardUnknown is false.
protoreflect.Message.SetUnknown accepts empty RawFields to clear unknown fields.
Known fields and unknown raw fields occupy distinct message channels.

prospective_mapping_before_hosted_execut.R_REDECODE_PRESERVE: Default proto.Unmarshal from fixed raw wire restores known field and unknown raw bytes.
prospective_mapping_before_hosted_execut.D_DROP_UNKNOWN: ProtoReflect.SetUnknown(nil) clears unknown raw bytes without changing known field.
prospective_mapping_before_hosted_execut.source_orientation_rule: Both R and D overwrite the same UNKNOWN_OR_FUTURE_FIELD availability coordinate to distinct fixed values while raw wire is held fixed.

property_indexed_prediction.KNOWN_CURRENT_FIELD_OR_CAPABILITY: PRESERVED under default and DiscardUnknown decode
property_indexed_prediction.UNKNOWN_OR_FUTURE_FIELD_OR_CAPABILITY: PRESERVED when DiscardUnknown=false; DROPPED when true

hosted_required: construct dynamic proto3 message with known field #1
wire payload contains known #1 and unknown #2
default unmarshal preserves #1 and stores #2 as unknown
